[.verse-line]
[.i88]##{nbsp}##My neighbour _H----y_ by his pleasing tongue,
[.i90]##{nbsp}##Hath won a Girl that’s rich, wise, fair and young;
[.i72]##{nbsp}##The Match (he saith) is half concluded, he
[.i85]##{nbsp}##Indeed is wondrous willing; but not she.
[.i94]##{nbsp}##And reason good, for he has run thro’ all
[.i92]##{nbsp}##Almost the story of the Prodigal;
[.i85]##{nbsp}##Yet swears he never with the hogs did dine;
[.i67]##{nbsp}##That’s true, for none would trust him with their swine.
